items.title: 4.1.7.1 Operations on Tree (Insertion, Deletion, Traversal: In-order, Pre-order, Post-order; Searching) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of tree operations (PDF 109-111).

blocks.text: Tree mein kuch basic (bunyadi) operations hain jo data sambhalne aur us par kaam karne mein madad dete hain:

items: Insertion (dalna): sochiye aap family tree mein naya member jor rahe hain. Tree mein sahi jagah dhoond kar naya member wahan jorte hain, yaani naye shakhs ko us ke parent (maa ya baap) se jor dete hain taake woh khandan ka hissa ban jaye.
Deletion (nikalna): kabhi kisi member ko tree se hatana parta hai. Use dhyan se nikala jata hai taake baqi tree jura rahe aur sahi rahe.

Traversal (har node dekhna): yeh family tree mein har member ke paas ja kar milne jaisa hai. Is ke kai tareeqe hain, jaise oopar se shuru kar ke ek ek member dekhna, ya agli shaakh par jane se pehle kisi shakhs ke saare bachche dekhna. Teen aam traversals hain: In-order, Pre-order aur Post-order. Inhein samajhne ke liye neeche numbers wala saada tree istemal hoga.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai “Here's how you can insert a new member into the Family Tree:” magar is ke baad koi code nahi diya. 4.1.6.1 ke family tree program mein naya member add_child() se jurta hai, maslan family_tree.add_child('Parent1', 'Child3').

blocks.alt: Teeron wala binary tree: oopar 1; us ka baen bachcha 2 aur daen bachcha 3; 2 ke neeche 4 aur 5; 3 ke neeche 6 aur 7.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.8: Numeric data (numbers) wala tree (kitab ki Figure 4.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka; traversals ke mutabiq 2 baen taraf).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 4.8 ulti (mirror) chhapi hai: us mein 3 baen taraf (neeche 7, 6) aur 2 daen taraf (neeche 5, 4) hai. Magar kitab ke apne jawab, maslan in-order 4, 2, 5, 1, 6, 3, 7, tabhi sahi hain jab 2 baen aur 3 daen ho. Is liye yahan durust tree banaya gaya hai. In-order: pehle baen shaakh (4, 2, 5), phir root 1, phir daen shaakh (6, 3, 7).
Is tree ki root node ki value 1 hai. Is ke do child nodes 2 aur 3 hain, aur un ke bhi children hain, jaisa Figure 4.8 mein hai: 2 ke neeche 4 aur 5, aur 3 ke neeche 6 aur 7.
1. In-order traversal
In-order mein pehle baen (left) subtree, phir root node, aur aakhir mein daen (right) subtree dekhte hain.
Misal: upar wale tree ka in-order traversal:

items: Node 4 (2 ke sab se baen wala node)
Node 6 (3 ke sab se baen wala node)

blocks.text: In-order output: 4, 2, 5, 1, 6, 3, 7.
2. Pre-order traversal
Pre-order mein pehle root node, phir baen subtree, phir daen subtree dekhte hain.
Misal: upar wale tree ka pre-order traversal:

items: Node 4 (2 ke sab se baen wala node)
Node 6 (3 ke sab se baen wala node)

blocks.text: Pre-order output: 1, 2, 4, 5, 3, 6, 7.
3. Post-order traversal
Post-order mein pehle baen subtree, phir daen subtree, aur aakhir mein root node dekhte hain. (Kitab mein yahan jumla “For our” adhoora reh gaya hai.)
Misal: upar wale tree ka post-order traversal:

items: Node 4 (2 ke sab se baen wala node)
Node 6 (3 ke sab se baen wala node)

blocks.text: Post-order output: 4, 5, 2, 6, 7, 3, 1.

Searching (dhoondna): yeh family tree mein kisi khaas member ko dhoondne jaisa hai. Hum tree mein ek ek shakhs check karte hain jab tak woh shakhs na mil jaye jise dhoond rahe hain. Is se tree mein information jaldi mil jati hai.
Khud chala kar dekhein

Yeh program Figure 4.8 wale tree ke teeno traversals chhapta hai. left aur right batate hain ke har node ka baen aur daen child kaun hai. root badal kar (maslan 2) ya naya child jor kar Run karein aur naye orders dekhein.

blocks.prompt: Kaunsa traversal root node ko us ke children se pehle dekhta hai (MCQ 7)?
In-order, pre-order aur post-order traversals ko misal ke saath samjhaiye (long question 6).
blocks.explanation: Har ek tareeqa har subtree par dobara (recursively) lagta hai. In-order: pehle baen subtree, phir node, phir daen subtree; upar wale tree par 4, 2, 5, 1, 6, 3, 7. Pre-order: node pehle, phir dono subtrees; 1, 2, 4, 5, 3, 6, 7; oopar se neeche copy ya backup ke liye useful (faidemand). Post-order: dono subtrees pehle, node aakhir mein; 4, 5, 2, 6, 7, 3, 1; folder mitane se pehle us ka andar ka saman mitane ke liye useful.
